 shaft and pump shaft and record them.

Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng Medhat Foaad, tested at 03 June 2003, revised by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Abouda Elbana, accepted by general 
manager eng Ali Mostafa El_Lithy and Approved by Mostafa Alaam Talkha PS Head 
Sector.
Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should cany the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the 
pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of the 
pump motor..
The
pump must be isolated mechanically by 
closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely 
drainage.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.Manual 
puller.
Feeler 
gauge, 
 Dial 
indicator
Vibrometer, 
Straight edge, 
 Rags.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.Manual 
puller.
Feeler 
gauge, 
 Dial 
indicator
Vibrometer, 
Straight edge, 
 Rags.
Work to be carried out
Disassembly
Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure and record them.
Check the vibration level of the 
 pump set complete with the motor then, record them.
Measure the pump alignment and 
 record it.
Unscrew the shaft end nut and take 
 the pump half-coupling out.
Dismantle the attached pipes.
Dismount the gland and take packing 
 cords out.
Discharge the oil tank of the 
 bearing and dismount the taper-roller bearing (29415) and the radial bearing 
 (1213k).
Dismantle the stand, which carries 
 the electric motor.
Take pump out of its place, after 
 disconnecting Condensate tank.
Dismantle clamping bolts and 
 dismantle impellers and diffusers beginning from suction up to the last stage.
Dismantle the lower shaft joint from 
 the mafe coupling.
Dismount the pipe guide and insert 
 the other joint of the shaft.
Inspection
The validity of journal bearing 
 white metal castings.
The validity of the anti-friction 
 bearings.
Check the radial clearances for pump 
 by measuring the gap between wearing rings of diffusers and the distance 
 sleeves on the shaft and record it.
Check all parts for any worn-out.
Check all parts for cracks.
Inspect the run-out of shafts.
Assembly
Clean the all contact surfaces.
Mount the impellers and diffusers of 
 the pump beginning from the delivery side up to suction side, then screw the 
 clamping bolts.
Fit the shaft with the pump into the 
 bearing hunger and tight it to the pump casing.
Fit the other joint of the shaft 
 with the mafe coupling.
Mount the guide pipe and the elbow 
 complete with the hunger.
Fit the gland sleeve and gland 
 housing and its accessories.
Install the stand of bearing housing 
 and motor.
Insert the tapered- roller bearing 
 and cover it, then refill the oil tank of the bearing.
Put the coupling half of the pump 
 and secure it and adjust axial clearance.
Lift the pump and place it in the 
 Condensate tank and tighten its bolts.
Adjust the axial clearance of the 
 pump by lifting the entire rotor in the upward direction until it stops by 
 means of the castle nut. At the same time, count the number of turns of the 
 nut up to the moment when the nut is fully tightened.
Tighten the attached pipes to the 
 pump.
Insert packing cord rings in the 
 stuffing box and tighten it easily.
Fit the motor on its stand.
Adjust the alignment between motor 
 shaft and pump shaft and record them.
Starting the Pump
Before 
starting the Pump, the following Steps should be checked
Check the oil level in the 
 thrust-bearing pump bath
Open the cooling water for the oil 
 bath of the thrust bearing.
Open the suction and delivery valves 
 of the pump.
Check the direction of rotation of 
 the pump by pushing the electric button of the motor pump instantaneously.
Attendance and Checking During operation
During operation of the Pump, 
the following should be checked
The temperature of the anti-friction 
 bearing (it should be not exceed 75C).
The temperature of cooling water.
Any water leakage and oil leakage.
The discharge quantity and pressures 
 (suction and discharge) of the pump and record them.
Check the vibration level and record 
 it.
